title: Parking garage occupancy counter with full interlock
nl_spec: A parking garage tracks occupancy with an up/down counter. A rising edge of EntrySensor means a car entered (increment occupancy); a rising edge of ExitSensor means a car left (decrement). Capacity is CAP = 3. Occupancy must stay within 0..CAP (never over-count or go negative). Assert FullSign when occupancy is at capacity. The entry barrier (EntryBarrierOpen) opens on EntryReq ONLY when the garage is not full. Use an internal INT Count (0..CAP) and internal BOOLs PrevEntry, PrevExit for edge detection. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named garage with inputs EntrySensor, ExitSensor, EntryReq and outputs FullSign, EntryBarrierOpen.

interface.name: EntryReq
interface.description: Car requesting entry at the barrier

safety_properties.nl: Occupancy never exceeds capacity (no over-admission count).
The entry barrier never opens while the garage is full.
The full sign is shown exactly when occupancy is at capacity.
The barrier only opens for a requesting car.

scenarios.description: Fill to capacity, then full interlock blocks entry
Fill to full (edge-triggered), then a car leaves

notes: Up/down counter with guarded increment/decrement (tests both bounds in the verifier) + full interlock on the barrier.
